text_block_list.text:
While preparing for early morning 
training—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning. I see you're here 
already.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I woke up feeling refreshed. Since I got 
up earlier than usual, I came to say 
hello.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, to tell you the truth, I was 
planning to surprise you with a greeting 
when you showed up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it seems even the "Emperor" 
cannot best you when it comes to waking up 
early. Heh.
